text:
maya: Heads up — PR #11844 (db-connection-pool + migration) is ready for merge but CI's 'db-migrations' job is flaky and failing intermittently. Deploy freeze starts 2026-03-19 00:00 UTC. Do we hold for the rebase window or land behind a feature flag?

sam: pinging reviewers — I can give final approval once CI is green or we have a clear rollback plan.

ci-bot: test-suite/db-migrations FAILED on runner macos-12 (flaky timeout). First failing step: `apply_migrations`. Log: https://ci.example/11844/logs (excerpt attached).

jordan: is the failure reproducible locally with `RUST_LOG=debug`? If it's a timing issue we might be able to split the migration to be non-blocking. Rebase window opens tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

lee: infra note — this PR bumps the postgres driver minor version; ops needs to sign off because it changes connection pooling behavior.

ops: noted. Deploy freeze means no infra changes after 00:00 UTC on 3/19 unless urgent. If this needs a DB driver bump we should aim to land before freeze or postpone to next window.

maya: we can do two things: 1) split migration into a two-step background migration (non-blocking), land code now and run migration during the maintenance window; or 2) land behind feature flag with migration gated to a manual offline run. Both require approvals.

sam: option 2 sounds safer short-term. Can we toggle flag quickly if something breaks? :thumbsup:

maya: yes, feature flag exists and can be toggled via the admin console. But the migration currently needs exclusive locks; that's why I suggested an offline run.

jordan: if we refactor migration to use phased approach (add nullable column, backfill async, then make not-null) we avoid exclusive locks. I'll sketch the split today and open a follow-up PR.

maya: nice — if you can open the split-migration PR before 09:00 UTC tomorrow we can target the rebase slot.

ana: @ana (security) — quick check: does the driver bump affect any audit logging or TLS settings? We need a quick thumbs.

ana: sorry typo — meant @ana.

ana: (bot correction) — ignore

ana: (oops) — my bad, re-posting correctly: @ana — quick check...

ana: (this is messy, ignore previous, continuing)

ana: we're waiting on ana's response

ana: @ana?

ana is a mess in thread but participants list includes ana. For clarity, replace those messy lines with concise ana messages.

ana: ana: I took a quick look. Driver bump doesn't change TLS defaults, but please include a short note in the security checklist and I'll sign off ASAP.

ci-bot: rerun requested by jordan at 1768505600 — queued.

sam: I can hold my approve until we see the rerun; if it's green + ana ok + ops ok, I'll approve and we can choose feature-flag landing.

lee: ops+infra signoff contingent on feature-flag + migration plan. If we do the phased migration PR and it lands tomorrow morning we can merge pre-freeze.

maya: command for manual offline migration (for ops run):
```
./scripts/run_migration --db-url $PG_OFFLINE --exclusive-lock --log-level info
```

maya: ops, if we go that route, can you carve out a 15-min window tonight before freeze?

ops: we have a 20-min slot at 22:30 UTC (tonight) but only if the migration is safe to run and infra approves.

jordan: I'll open the split-migration PR in the next hour and tag infra/security. If that lands, we can avoid the offline exclusive run and use the phased approach.

maya: great. tagging next steps: jordan opens split PR; ana quick sec sign-off; lee/ops confirm pre-freeze slot if needed; sam to approve after green.

sam: sounds good. I'll watch the rerun.

ci-bot: rerun finished at 1768507000 — db-migrations: flaky timeout reproduced on macos-12. Failing step still `apply_migrations`.

jordan: failure reproduced locally — investigating race in migration lock acquisition. Will push fix to split PR.

maya: thanks. leaving this thread open — will update when split PR is up or if we decide to land behind flag.

sam: thanks team :pray:
